in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Peace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anishka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anishka is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Anisha’, which means ‘Goddess of Peace’. This name is associated with calmness, tranquility, and serenity.
